title: Koguna, tafkuna da hamada
description: Ten stories of rivers, lakes and the desert: lead poisoning in a gold-washing village by a stream, an old fisherman and his grandson watching crocodile eggs hatch, a pickup truck that breaks down on a desert track beyond Agadez, a doctor's column on bilharzia and diarrhoea from lake water, a young woman's first day selling food at a lakeside market, a stabbing at a river ferry and an inspector who stops a sergeant torturing a suspect, the funeral of an old Sarkin Ruwa, a schoolgirl's essay on the advancing desert, a governor's promise to revive a shrinking lake, and a painter in Khartoum who paints where the two Niles meet.

lessons.title: Gubar dalma a bakin rafi
lessons.summary: In the village of Kwaren, people grind gold ore at home and wash it in the stream; children fall ill and die, and Dr Nana'ala finds lead in their blood; the village head has the grinding moved far away and the sites fenced off, and medicine saves Ummulkhairi's little son.
lessons.text:
A ƙauyen Kwaren, a cikin duwatsun da ke kusa da rafi, akwai zinariya birjik. Saboda haka mutane da yawa suna haƙar duwatsu. Suna kawo su gida, suna niƙa su a cikin gidajensu, sannan su wanke garin a bakin rafin domin su samo ɗan zinariya. Ba su sani ba cewa a cikin waɗannan duwatsu akwai dalma mai yawa.

A wannan shekara, yara ƙanana suka fara rashin lafiya. Wasu suna amai, wasu ba sa iya tafiya, wasu kuma suna suma. A cikin wata uku, cutar ta lakume rayukan yara fiye da talatin. Sababbin kaburbura sun yi birjik a gefen ƙauyen. Iyaye suka shiga tsoro, wasu suka ce sihiri ne.

Dakta Nana'ala, likita daga asibitin ƙaramar hukuma, ta zo ƙauyen. Ta ɗauki jinin yara, ta aika da shi zuwa wani ɗakin bincike a Abuja. Sakamakon ya nuna cewa jinin yaran cike yake da dalma. Ta ce wa Hakimin ƙauyen, Malam Ɗanmagori, "Ba sihiri ne yake lakume yaranku ba. Dalma ce. Garin duwatsun da kuke niƙawa a cikin gida yana shiga bakin yara, kuma yana shiga ruwan rafin da kuke sha."

Malam Ɗanmagori ya tambaye ta, "To me za mu yi? Zinariya ita ce abincinmu." Dakta Nana'ala ta ce, "Ban ce ku daina neman abinci ba. Amma dole a gusar da niƙa daga cikin gidaje, a kai shi nesa da ƙauye da rafi."

Washegari, mutanen ƙauyen suka taru. Hakimi ya umarci matasa su kange tsofaffin wuraren niƙa da itace da waya, don kada yara su shiga. Suka kuma kange ɓangaren rafin da aka fi wanke garin duwatsu. Aka gusar da injinan niƙa zuwa wani fili mai nisa.

Amma kafin a gama aikin, yawan yara marasa lafiya ya ruɓanya. A wata ɗaya an samu yara ɗari biyu marasa lafiya; a wata na gaba sun ruɓanya, sun kai ɗari huɗu. Dakta Nana'ala ta ce, "Idan ba a gusar da niƙa daga gidaje da sauri ba, wannan adadi zai sake ruɓanya." Gwamnati da wasu ƙungiyoyin agaji suka kawo magani. Maganin yana fitar da dalma daga jiki a hankali. Dakta Nana'ala ta ce, "Wannan magani zai tseratar da yara da yawa, amma sai uwaye sun kawo su asibiti a kan lokaci."

Ummulkhairi ta kawo ƙaramin ɗanta wanda ba ya iya tsayawa. Bayan mako shida yana shan magani, ya fara tafiya. Ta ce, "Maganin nan ya tseratar da ɗana. Allah ya saka wa likitoci da alheri."

Bayan shekara guda, babu yaron da ya mutu a Kwaren saboda dalma. Har yanzu zinariya tana nan birjik a duwatsun, kuma mutanen ƙauyen suna ci gaba da nemanta, amma yanzu ana niƙa da wanke duwatsu nesa da gidaje. Malam Ɗanmagori ya ce, "Mun koyi darasi mai tsada. Zinariya ba ta fi rayuwar yaranmu ba."

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa yaran Kwaren suka fara rashin lafiya?
Domin garin duwatsun da ake niƙawa a cikin gidaje yana ɗauke da dalma.
Yara nawa cutar ta lakume a cikin wata uku?
Cutar ta lakume rayukan yara fiye da talatin.
Me Hakimi ya umarci matasa su yi?
Ya umarce su su kange wuraren niƙa da ɓangaren rafin da aka fi wanke garin duwatsu.
Ina aka gusar da injinan niƙa?
An gusar da su zuwa wani fili mai nisa da ƙauye da rafi.
Me ya tseratar da ɗan Ummulkhairi?
Maganin da yake fitar da dalma daga jiki ne ya tseratar da shi.

lessons.title: 'Ya'yan kada
lessons.summary: The old fisherman Malam Ɗanjimma takes his grandson Mu'azu out on the river; the boy takes a crocodile for a lizard, and the grandfather shows him where the eggs are buried and laughs at the old superstitions of the river; two months later they watch the eggs hatch and the mother carry her young to the water.
lessons.text:
Malam Ɗanjimma masunci ne a wani ƙauye a bakin babban kogi. Mahaifinsa ma masunci ne, kakansa ma haka. A lokacin hutun makaranta, jikansa Mu'azu yakan zo daga birni ya zauna da shi.

Wata rana da sassafe suka shiga ƙaramin jirgin ruwa domin su duba ragarsu. Da suka wuce wani tsibirin yashi, Mu'azu ya ga wata babbar dabba tana kwance a kan yashi. Ya ce, "Kaka, duba wannan babban ƙadangare!" Malam Ɗanjimma ya yi dariya ya ce, "Ba ƙadangare ba ne, kada ne. Amma ka faɗi gaskiya: yana kama da ƙadangare sak, sai dai ya fi shi girma sau ɗari."

Da kadan ya ji motsin jirgin, sai ya faɗa cikin ruwa tsundum, ya ɓace. Ƙananan kifayen da ke gefen ruwa suka bazama ko'ina.

Malam Ɗanjimma ya kai jirgin bakin tsibirin. Ya nuna wa Mu'azu wani wuri inda aka tona yashi aka sake rufe shi. Ya ce, "A nan uwar kada ta binne ƙwayayenta. Rana ce take ɗumama su. Bayan wata biyu za su ƙyanƙyashe."

Mu'azu ya tambaya, "Kaka, shin gaskiya ne cewa idan masunci ya kashe kada, kogin zai yi fushi ya nutsar da shi?" Malam Ɗanjimma ya ce, "Wannan camfi ne na da. Kakana ya yarda da shi. Akwai camfi da yawa a bakin kogi. Wasu suna cewa kada a yi busa a kan ruwa da dare. Wasu suna cewa idan ƙadangare ya shiga jirgi, ba za a kama kifi ba. Ni ban yarda da camfi ba, amma ina girmama kada, domin yana da haɗari."

Bayan wata biyu Mu'azu ya dawo. Kakansa ya ce masa, "Ka zo, lokaci ya yi. Ƙwayayen sun kusa ƙyanƙyashe." Suka je tsibirin da sassafe, suka ɓoye a bayan ciyawa. Ba a jima ba suka ji ƙananan muryoyi a ƙarƙashin yashi. Sai uwar ta fito daga ruwa, ta tona yashin da ƙafafunta. 'Ya'yan kada suka fito ɗaya bayan ɗaya. Kowanne ya yi kama da uwarsa sak, sai dai bai fi tsawon hannu ba. Uwar ta ɗauke su a bakinta a hankali, ta kai su gefen ruwa. Suka bazama a cikin ciyawa, sannan kowanne ya shiga ruwa tsundum.

Mu'azu ya ce, "Kaka, ban taɓa ganin abin mamaki irin wannan ba." Malam Ɗanjimma ya ce, "Shekara hamsin ina masunci a kogin nan. Duk lokacin da ƙwayaye suka ƙyanƙyashe, nakan zo in kalla. Masunci mai hankali yana kallon kogi, yana koyo, ba ya bin camfi."

Tambayoyi:
Me Mu'azu ya ce kadan ne da farko?
Ya ce babban ƙadangare ne.
Me kadan ya yi da ya ji motsin jirgin?
Ya faɗa cikin ruwa tsundum, ya ɓace, ƙananan kifaye kuma suka bazama.
Wane camfi Mu'azu ya tambayi kakansa a kai?
Ya tambaye shi ko kogi zai nutsar da masuncin da ya kashe kada.
Me ya faru da ƙwayayen bayan wata biyu?
Sun ƙyanƙyashe, uwar kuma ta kai 'ya'yanta gefen ruwa a bakinta.
Yaya 'ya'yan kada suke?
Kowanne yana kama da uwarsa sak, sai dai bai fi tsawon hannu ba.

lessons.title: Mota a cikin hamada
lessons.summary: Attaher leaves Agadez in a hurry with his cousin Mahaman to take goods to Timia; where the tarred road ends a nail punctures a tyre, and later the exhaust pipe breaks on a rock; with dry throats they reach a small settlement where the mechanic Ahmoudou welds the pipe and warns them against haste.
lessons.text:
Attaher direba ne a Agadez. Yana da tsohuwar mota mai baya a buɗe, kuma yana kai kaya zuwa ƙauyukan da ke cikin duwatsu da hamada. Wata rana wani ɗan kasuwa ya kira shi da safe ya ce, "Ina son kayan nan su isa Timia kafin dare." Attaher ya ɗora kayan cikin garaje, ya ɗauki ɗan'uwansa Mahaman, suka tashi. Saboda garaje, bai duba tayar da ke baya ba, kuma ruwan da suka ɗauka bai yi yawa ba.

Da farko hanyar kwalta ce, kuma mota tana tafiya da kyau. Amma bayan awa biyu kwalta ta ƙare, suka shiga hanyar yashi da duwatsu. Ba a jima ba suka ji ƙara, mota ta karkata. Attaher ya sauka ya duba. Wani babban ƙusa ya shiga tayar gaba. Ya ce, "Ban san yadda ƙusa ya zo cikin hamada ba!" Mahaman ya ce, "Wataƙila a kan kwalta ne ya shiga, sai yanzu iska ta ƙare."

Suka canza tayar, suka sake tashi. Rana ta yi zafi sosai. Bayan awa ɗaya, mota ta bugi wani dutse, sai suka ji wata ƙara mai ƙarfi a ƙarƙashinta. Bututun hayaƙi ya karye, ya fara jan ƙasa. Mota tana ihu kamar jirgin sama.

Ruwansu ya kusa ƙarewa. Maƙoshin Mahaman ya bushe har ba ya iya magana sosai. Ya ce, "Maƙoshina yana ƙonewa." Attaher ya ba shi ruwan ƙarshe, shi kuma ya haƙura. Suka ci gaba da tafiya a hankali har suka isa wata ƙaramar unguwa a gefen wani rafi mai bushewa.

A can akwai wani bakanike mai suna Ahmoudou. Yana da ƙaramin injin wuta da kayan walda. Ya ba su ruwan sanyi daga tulu tukuna, sannan ya kwanta a ƙarƙashin motar. Ya ce, "Bututun ya karye biyu. Sai walda." Ya sa gilashin walda a fuskarsa, ya kunna inji. Tartsatsin wuta ya yi ta tashi. Cikin minti talatin ya gama walda, bututun ya zauna daram.

Bakaniken ya kuma cire ƙusa daga tayar da ta fashe, ya gyara ta. Attaher ya biya shi, ya gode masa. Ahmoudou ya ce, "Ɗan'uwa, hamada ba ta son garaje. Kafin ka bar kwalta, ka duba tayoyinka, ka ɗauki ruwa mai yawa. Bushewar maƙoshi ta fi tayar da ta fashe haɗari."

Sun isa Timia bayan magariba. Ɗan kasuwar bai yi fushi ba. Tun daga ranar, kafin Attaher ya tashi daga Agadez, yakan duba tayoyi, ya ɗauki jarkokin ruwa biyu.

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa Attaher bai duba tayar baya ba?
Domin ya ɗora kayan cikin garaje.
Me ya shiga tayar gaba?
Wani babban ƙusa ne ya shiga tayar.
Me ya faru da bututun hayaƙi?
Mota ta bugi dutse, sai bututun hayaƙi ya karye.
Me ya sa Mahaman ba ya iya magana sosai?
Domin maƙoshinsa ya bushe saboda zafi da ƙarancin ruwa.
Yaya bakanike Ahmoudou ya gyara bututun?
Ya yi masa walda da ƙaramin injin wutarsa.

lessons.title: Likitanku: cututtukan ruwan tafki
lessons.summary: In her newspaper health column, Dr Hanne answers Malam Tasi'u, a fisherman from Baga on Lake Chad whose son passes blood in his urine and whose daughter has diarrhoea: she explains bilharzia, which harms the bladder and kidneys or the bowel, says a quarter of lakeside children carry it, and advises boiled water and cooked food.
lessons.text:
Likitanku: Dakta Hanne tana amsa tambayoyinku a kan lafiya.

Tambaya: "Dakta, ni masunci ne a Baga, a bakin Tafkin Chadi. Ɗana mai shekara goma yana ganin jini a fitsarinsa. 'Yata, ƙanwarsa, kuma tana fama da zawo kusan kowane mako. Mutane sun ce wai saboda zafi ne. Me zan yi?" Malam Tasi'u, Baga.

Amsa: Malam Tasi'u, na gode da wannan tambaya, domin iyaye da yawa a ƙauyukan bakin tafki suna fama da irin wannan matsala. Jini a fitsarin yaro ba abu ne da za a ɗauka da sauƙi ba, kuma ba zafi ba ne yake kawo shi.

Akwai wata cuta da ake kira tsagiya. Ƙananan tsutsotsi ne da ke rayuwa a cikin ruwan tafki da rafi. Idan yaro ya yi wanka ko ya yi iyo a cikin ruwan, tsutsotsin suna shiga jikinsa ta fata. Akwai iri biyu. Iri na farko yana zama a cikin mafitsara, yana sa jini a fitsari. Idan aka bar shi shekaru, zai iya ɓata ƙoda. Ƙoda tana tace jini, kuma idan ƙoda ta lalace, rayuwar mutum tana cikin haɗari. Iri na biyu yana zama a cikin hanji. Yana sa ciwon ciki, wani lokaci kuma jini yana fitowa ta dubura tare da bayan gida. Idan yaro yana ganin jini daga dubura, a kai shi asibiti nan da nan.

Bincike a ƙauyukan bakin Tafkin Chadi ya nuna cewa kusan rubu'in yara suna da wannan cuta. Wato daga cikin yara huɗu, ɗaya yana da ita. Wannan rubu'i ba ƙarami ba ne. Labari mai daɗi shi ne, akwai magani kyauta a asibitocin gwamnati, ana shan ƙwaya sau ɗaya kawai.

Zawon 'yarka kuma wani abu ne daban. Zawo yana zuwa ne daga ƙwayoyin cuta da ke cikin ruwa marar tsabta ko abinci da ya lalace. Yaro mai zawo yana rasa ruwa a jikinsa da sauri. Ka ba ta ruwa mai gishiri da sukari kaɗan bayan kowane zawo, kuma ka kai ta asibiti idan ba ta daina ba a cikin kwana biyu.

Shawarata ga iyali:
Na farko, kada ku sha ruwan tafki kai tsaye. Ku sha tafasasshen ruwa kawai. Ku tafasa ruwan, ku bar shi ya huce, sannan ku zuba shi a cikin tulu mai murfi. Tafasasshen ruwa ba shi da ƙwayoyin cuta.
Na biyu, ku ci dafaffen abinci mai zafi. Kada ku ajiye dafaffen abinci har kwana biyu. Abinci dafaffe sosai, wanda aka ci da zafinsa, ba ya kawo zawo. Kifin da aka kama a tafki sai an dafa shi sosai.
Na uku, ku hana yara yin iyo a wuraren da ruwa ba ya gudu.

Ka kai ɗanka da 'yarka asibiti yau, kada ka jira gobe.

Tambayoyi:
Me ɗan Malam Tasi'u yake gani a fitsarinsa?
Yana ganin jini a fitsarinsa.
Wace gaɓa ce iri na farko na tsagiya zai iya ɓatawa?
Zai iya ɓata ƙoda, wadda take tace jini.
Yara nawa ne suke da cutar a ƙauyukan bakin tafki?
Kusan rubu'in yara, wato ɗaya daga cikin huɗu.
Me ya kamata a ba yaro mai zawo?
A ba shi ruwa mai gishiri da sukari kaɗan bayan kowane zawo.
Me ya kamata a yi idan yaro yana ganin jini daga dubura?
A kai shi asibiti nan da nan.
Wane ruwa da wane abinci ne Dakta Hanne ta ce iyali su sha, su ci?
Ta ce su sha tafasasshen ruwa kawai, su ci dafaffen abinci mai zafi.

lessons.title: Kasuwar bakin tafki
lessons.summary: On her first market day at the lakeside market by Kainji, Hindatu sells fried fish and moringa salad but no one buys because her prices are high; her aunt Kulu tells her to sell cheaply in small clay bowls and to add pineapple juice; by evening everything is sold, and she buys herself an indigo-dyed wrapper.
lessons.text:
Kowace Lahadi akwai babbar kasuwa a bakin Tafkin Kainji. Masunta suna kawo kifi daga cikin tafki, manoma kuma suna kawo kayan gona daga ƙauyukan da ke kewaye. Hindatu budurwa ce mai shekara sha takwas. Ta ƙudiri aniyar fara sana'a a kasuwar.

Da sassafe ta sayi kifi sabo daga wurin masunta. Ta wanke shi, ta sa masa gishiri da yaji, sannan ta toya shi a cikin mai mai zafi. Ta kuma dafa ganyen zogale, ta haɗa shi da tumatir, albasa da kuli-kuli. Zogale yana da amfani ga lafiya, kuma mutanen garin suna son sa. Ta ɗauki kayanta zuwa kasuwa da wuri.

Amma har rana ta yi, babu wanda ya saya. Mutane suna tsayawa, suna tambayar farashi, sannan su wuce. Kifin da ta toya ya fara hucewa. Hindatu ta yi baƙin ciki.

Goggonta Kulu tana sayar da abarba a kusa da ita. Kulu ta daɗe a kasuwar. Ta zo ta ce, "Hindatu, kayanki suna da kyau, amma farashinki ya yi yawa. Masunta da 'yan kasuwar nan ba su da kuɗi da yawa. Abu mai araha shi ne yake saurin ƙarewa a wannan kasuwa." Ta ci gaba da cewa, "Ki yanka kifin ƙanana, ki sa kowanne a cikin kasko tare da ɗan zogale. Kasko ɗaya, farashi ɗaya mai araha. Mutum ɗaya zai iya sayen kasko biyu ko uku."

Kulu ta ba ta kasko goma daga cikin kayanta. Kasko ƙaramin kwano ne na ƙasa, kuma abinci yana zama mai zafi a ciki. Kulu ta kuma ce, "Abarbana ta nuna sosai a yau. Bari mu matse wasu mu yi ruwan abarba. Idan mutum ya ci kifin da aka toya da yaji, zai so ya sha abu mai sanyi."

Suka matse abarba biyar, suka zuba ruwan a cikin kwalabe. Hindatu ta rage farashinta. Ba a jima ba masunta suka fara zuwa. Wani ya sayi kasko biyu na kifi da zogale da kwalbar ruwan abarba. Wani kuma ya kira abokansa. Kafin la'asar kifin da ta toya ya ƙare, zogale ma ya ƙare, ruwan abarba ma ya ƙare.

Da yamma Hindatu ta ƙirga kuɗinta. Ribar ba ta yi yawa ba, amma ta fi ta safe nesa. A gefen kasuwa akwai wata tsohuwa mai sayar da zannuwan rini. Ana yin rinin da shuni, saboda haka launin zannuwan shuɗi ne mai duhu. Hindatu ta sayi zani ɗaya na rini daga ribarta, ta mayar wa Goggo Kulu kaskonta, ta ce, "Mako mai zuwa zan zo da kasko nawa."

Kulu ta yi dariya ta ce, "Kin koyi sirrin kasuwa: abu mai kyau, kuma mai araha."

Tambayoyi:
Me Hindatu ta toya da safe?
Ta toya kifi sabo a cikin mai mai zafi.
Me ya sa mutane ba su saya ba da farko?
Domin farashinta ya yi yawa.
Me Kulu ta ce ta sa kifin a ciki?
Ta ce ta sa shi a cikin kasko tare da ɗan zogale.
Me suka yi da abarba?
Sun matse ta, suka yi ruwan abarba.
Me Hindatu ta saya da ribarta?
Ta sayi zani ɗaya na rini, mai launin shuɗi mai duhu.

lessons.title: Wuƙa a bakin jirgin ruwa
lessons.summary: At a river ferry a trader, Alhaji Muntari, is stabbed and robbed; Corporal Ɗanladi arrests a young porter, and Sergeant Bitrus beats him to force a confession and hurts his jaw; Inspector Hamisu stops the torture and the public humiliation, the ferryman's evidence leads to the real thief, and the porter is freed with an apology.
lessons.text:
A bakin kogi akwai wurin da manyan jiragen ruwa suke ɗaukar mutane da kaya zuwa ɗaya gefen. Wata rana da yamma, Alhaji Muntari, ɗan kasuwar shinkafa, yana jiran jirgi da jakar kuɗinsa. Sai wani mutum ya zo daga baya ya caka masa wuƙa a kafaɗa, ya ƙwace jakar, ya gudu cikin taron jama'a.

Mutane suka yi ihu. Kofur Ɗanladi, ɗan sanda mai tsaron wurin, ya zo da sauri. Ya ga wani matashi ɗan dako, Ayuba, yana gudu a cikin jama'a. Kofur ya kama shi, ya ce, "Kai ne ka caka wa Alhaji wuƙa!" Ayuba ya ce, "Wallahi ba ni ba ne! Na ji ihu ne, na ji tsoro." Aka kai Alhaji Muntari asibiti, raunin ba mai zurfi ba ne.

Kofur ya kai Ayuba ofishin 'yan sanda na bakin kogi. A can Saja Bitrus ya karɓe shi. Saja Bitrus mutum ne mai saurin fushi. Ya ce, "Za ka faɗi gaskiya yau." Ya fara dukan Ayuba don ya yarda da laifin. Ya buge shi a fuska har muƙamuƙinsa ya kumbura, ba ya iya buɗe baki sosai. Daga nan Saja ya fito da shi waje, ya tsayar da shi a gaban mutane, ya ce, "Ku dubi ɓarawon da ya caka wa Alhaji wuƙa!"

A lokacin ne Sufeto Hamisu, shugaban ofishin, ya dawo. Da ya ga abin da ke faruwa, ya ce, "Saja, ka shigo da shi nan da nan!" A ciki ya ce wa Saja Bitrus, "Gallazawa ga wanda ake zargi laifi ne a doka. Kuma tozarci ne ka tsayar da mutum a gaban jama'a kafin kotu ta same shi da laifi. Idan ba shi ne ba, wa zai mayar masa da mutuncinsa?" Saja ya yi shiru.

Sufeto ya sa aka kai Ayuba asibiti a duba muƙamuƙinsa. Sannan ya tafi bakin kogi da Kofur Ɗanladi. Suka sami Malam Ɗangoma, mai tuƙa jirgin. Malam Ɗangoma ya ce, "Na ga wanda ya caka wa Alhaji wuƙa. Yana sanye da doguwar riga ja, kuma ya shiga wani ƙaramin jirgi ya haye kogi. Ba ɗan dakon nan ba ne."

Washegari 'yan sanda na ɗaya gefen kogi suka kama mutumin mai jar riga. An sami jakar Alhaji Muntari a gidansa, kuma ya amsa laifinsa.

Sufeto Hamisu ya saki Ayuba, ya ba shi haƙuri a gaban mutanen da suka ga tozarcin da aka yi masa. Ya kuma rubuta rahoto kan gallazawar da Saja Bitrus ya yi, aka dakatar da shi daga aiki. Sufeto ya ce wa Kofur Ɗanladi, "Ka yi kyau da ka zo da sauri. Amma gudu ba laifi ba ne. Kafin ka ce wani ne ya aikata laifi, ka nemi shaida."

Tambayoyi:
Me mutumin ya yi wa Alhaji Muntari?
Ya caka masa wuƙa a kafaɗa, ya ƙwace jakar kuɗinsa.
Wa ya kama Ayuba?
Kofur Ɗanladi ne ya kama shi.
Me ya faru da muƙamuƙin Ayuba?
Saja Bitrus ya buge shi a fuska har muƙamuƙinsa ya kumbura.
Me Sufeto Hamisu ya ce game da gallazawa?
Ya ce gallazawa ga wanda ake zargi laifi ne a doka.
Me ya sa Sufeto ya ce abin da Saja ya yi a waje tozarci ne?
Domin ya tsayar da Ayuba a gaban jama'a kafin kotu ta same shi da laifi.
Me ya sa aka gane Ayuba ba shi ne ɓarawon ba?
Malam Ɗangoma, mai tuƙa jirgin, ya ga ɓarawon na gaske yana sanye da jar riga.

lessons.title: Wafatin Sarkin Ruwa
lessons.summary: In Yauri the old Sarkin Ruwa, Alhaji Mamuda, chief of the river people for forty years, dies at dawn as his lamp burns low; the emir sends his guards to the funeral, fishermen and boatmen of every people come, and his son Haladu resolves to keep the brotherhood of the river that his father built.
lessons.text:
A garin Yauri, a bakin babban kogi, akwai sarautar Sarkin Ruwa. Sarkin Ruwa shi ne shugaban masunta da masu jiragen ruwa. Shi ne yake raba wuraren kamun kifi, yake sasanta rigima a kan ruwa, kuma yake yin addu'a kafin a fara babban kamun kifi na shekara. Alhaji Mamuda ya shafe shekara arba'in a kan wannan sarauta.

A cikin shekararsa ta ƙarshe, ya tsufa sosai, ba ya iya fita zuwa kogi. Yakan zauna a ɗakinsa kusa da taga, yana kallon ruwa. Kowace rana da asubahi, ɗansa Haladu yakan kawo masa ruwan alwala, su yi sallar asubahi tare.

Wata rana da asubahi, Haladu ya shigo da ruwan alwala. Fitilar da ke ɗakin ta kusa ƙarewa; haskenta ya dushe. Mahaifinsa ya kalle shi ya ce, "Haladu, ka kula da mutanen kogi. Su 'yan'uwa ne." Bayan 'yan mintuna, sai numfashinsa ya tsaya. Hasken fitilar ma ya dushe gaba ɗaya. Haladu ya yi kuka a hankali, ya rufe idanun mahaifinsa.

Labarin wafatin Sarkin Ruwa ya bazu cikin gari kafin rana ta fito. Mutane suka fara zuwa gidan. Sarkin Yauri ya aiko da dogarai shida. Dogaran sun zo da jajayen rawuna, suka tsaya a ƙofar gida, suka taimaka wajen tsara jama'a. Wani babban dogari ya karanta saƙon Sarki: "Sarki yana ta'aziyya ga iyalin Sarkin Ruwa. Wafatinsa babban rashi ne ga ƙasar nan."

Jama'a sun zo daga ko'ina. Akwai masunta Hausawa, akwai Nufawa masu jiragen ruwa, akwai Sorkawa daga ƙauyukan tsibirai, har da wasu daga ɗaya gefen kogi. Suna magana da harsuna daban-daban, amma duk sun yi kuka tare. Wani tsoho masunci ya ce wa Haladu, "Mahaifinka ya koya mana ƴan'uwantaka. A da muna faɗa a kan wuraren kamun kifi. Shi ne ya ce kogi ɗaya ne, kuma mu 'yan'uwa ne. Wannan ƴan'uwantaka ita ce gadonsa."

An yi jana'iza bayan azahar. Dogarai sun ɗauki gawar tare da 'ya'yansa zuwa makabarta. Bayan an binne shi, Haladu ya tsaya a gaban jama'a ya ce, "Na ƙudurta zan ci gaba da aikin mahaifina. Na ƙudurta ba zan bari wani ya raba mu ba. Duk wanda yake kamun kifi a wannan kogi ɗan'uwana ne."

Bayan wata uku da wafatin mahaifinsa, Sarkin Yauri ya naɗa Haladu sabon Sarkin Ruwa. A ranar naɗin, ya yi sallar asubahi a bakin kogi tare da masunta, sannan ya buɗe kamun kifi na shekara.

Tambayoyi:
Wane aiki ne Sarkin Ruwa yake yi?
Shi ne shugaban masunta da masu jiragen ruwa; yana raba wuraren kamun kifi, yana sasanta rigima.
Yaushe Alhaji Mamuda ya rasu?
Ya rasu da asubahi, lokacin da hasken fitila ya dushe.
Wa Sarkin Yauri ya aiko zuwa gidan?
Ya aiko da dogarai shida.
Me tsohon masunci ya ce game da ƴan'uwantaka?
Ya ce Alhaji Mamuda ne ya koya musu ƴan'uwantaka, kuma ita ce gadonsa.
Me Haladu ya ƙudurta?
Ya ƙudurta zai ci gaba da aikin mahaifinsa, ba zai bari a raba su ba.

lessons.title: Muƙalar Zuwaira
lessons.summary: In Zinder, the schoolgirl Zuwaira enters an essay competition on the advancing desert; she drafts in pencil, compares her grandmother Tasalla's village of fifty years ago with today, likens the sand to a slow fire, adds a historical part about a ruined old palace under the dunes, and her teacher Malama Rabi'atu praises her cleverness when she wins.
lessons.text:
Makarantar sakandaren Zuwaira da ke Zinder ta shirya gasar rubutun muƙala. Taken gasar shi ne "Hamada tana zuwa." Malamarsu, Malama Rabi'atu, ta ce, "Kowace muƙala kada ta wuce shafi uku. Ku rubuta abin da kuka gani da idanunku, ba abin da kuka ji a rediyo kawai ba."

Zuwaira ta je gida ta ɗauki fensir da takarda. Ta fi son rubutu da fensir da farko, domin idan ta yi kuskure, sai ta goge. Ta yi tunani: me ta sani game da hamada?

Sai ta tuna da kakarta, Kaka Tasalla, wadda ta girma a wani ƙauye a arewacin Zinder. Zuwaira ta kira ta ta waya, ta ce, "Kaka, yaya ƙauyenku yake a lokacin kina yarinya?" Kaka Tasalla ta ce, "A lokacin akwai bishiyoyi da yawa, akwai tafki a gefen ƙauye, shanu suna shan ruwa a ciki. Yanzu tafkin ya bushe, yashi ya rufe rabin gonaki, kuma yawancin matasa sun tafi birni."

Zuwaira ta rubuta wannan kwatanci a farkon muƙalarta: ƙauyen kakarta shekara hamsin da suka wuce, da ƙauyen a yau. Kwatancin ya nuna yadda hamada take cin ƙasa a hankali.

Sannan ta nemi yadda za ta misalta hamada ga mai karatu. Ta rubuta: "Ana iya misalta hamada da wuta mai ci a hankali. Ba ka ganin harshenta, amma kowace shekara tana cinye gona ɗaya, rijiya ɗaya, ƙauye ɗaya." Ta kuma misalta bishiyoyi da katanga da ke tsare gari daga maƙiya.

Malama Rabi'atu ta ce wa ɗalibai su ƙara wani sashe na tarihi. Zuwaira ta je ɗakin karatu na gari. A can ta karanta cewa a tarihance, akwai garuruwa da dama a yankin da hamada ta rufe. Wani littafi ya ba da labarin wata rusasshiyar fada a arewa, wadda yashi ya rufe rabinta. Katangunanta na ƙasa sun faɗi, sai ƙofa ɗaya kawai ta rage. Zuwaira ta rubuta: "A tarihance, mutane sun sha guje wa hamada. Rusasshiyar fadar nan shaida ce cewa ba sabon abu ba ne."

A ƙarshen muƙalarta ta ba da shawara: a dasa bishiyoyi a kewayen kowane ƙauye, a kare tafkuna, a koya wa yara muhimmancin itace. Ta karanta abin da ta rubuta da fensir sau uku, sannan ta rubuta shi da alƙalami a kan takarda mai tsabta.

Bayan mako biyu aka sanar da sakamako. Muƙalar Zuwaira ce ta farko. Malama Rabi'atu ta ce a gaban aji, "Haziƙanci ba wai sanin abubuwa da yawa ba ne kawai. Haziƙanci shi ne ka ga abin da ke kusa da kai, ka bayyana shi da kyau. Zuwaira ta yi kwatanci da kakarta, ta misalta hamada da wuta, kuma ta haɗa da tarihi. Wannan shi ne haziƙanci."

Tambayoyi:
Mene ne taken gasar muƙala?
Taken shi ne "Hamada tana zuwa."
Me ya sa Zuwaira take son rubutu da fensir?
Domin idan ta yi kuskure, sai ta goge.
Wane kwatanci Zuwaira ta yi a farkon muƙalarta?
Ta yi kwatanci tsakanin ƙauyen kakarta shekara hamsin da suka wuce da ƙauyen a yau.
Da me ta misalta hamada?
Ta misalta ta da wuta mai ci a hankali.
Me ta rubuta game da rusasshiyar fada?
Ta rubuta cewa shaida ce cewa a tarihance mutane sun sha guje wa hamada.

lessons.title: Alƙawarin tafki
lessons.summary: A columnist describes how Governor Shamsuddeen, seeking a second term, promises to revive the shrinking lake with a canal; the opposition leader Hajiya Ladidi lashes out at the plan; at a rally, youths stirred up by politicians clash with opposition supporters, the violence dims his chances and blunts the project, and the columnist asks that the lake not be used as a campaign tool.
lessons.text:
Sharhi: Tafki ba kayan yaƙin neman zaɓe ba ne

A jiharmu akwai wani babban tafki da ya kasance tushen rayuwar dubban mutane. Masunta suna kamun kifi a cikinsa, manoma suna noman rani a gefensa, makiyaya kuma suna shayar da dabbobinsu. Amma a cikin shekaru talatin da suka wuce, tafkin ya ragu da fiye da rabi.

A wannan shekara, Gwamna Shamsuddeen yana neman tazarce. Wa'adinsa na farko yana ƙarewa, kuma yana son a sake zaɓensa. A babban taron jam'iyyarsa, ya yi alƙawari: "Idan kun ba ni tazarce, zan rayar da tafkinmu. Za mu haƙa babbar hanyar ruwa daga kogi zuwa tafkin, ruwa zai dawo, kifi zai dawo." Mutane da yawa sun yi murna. Mai rayar da tafki, in ji su, shi ne mai rayar da jiha.

Amma shugabar 'yan adawa, Hajiya Ladidi, ta caccaki wannan shiri. A wani taron manema labarai ta ce, "Wannan shiri ba shi da kasafin kuɗi, ba a yi nazarin muhalli ba, kuma an fara maganarsa ne kawai saboda tazarce. Gwamna ya yi shekara huɗu bai yi komai ba." Jaridu da dama ma sun caccaki gwamnati, suna cewa kuɗin aikin zai iya ninka abin da aka faɗa.

Bayan mako biyu, aka shirya taron gangami a garin da ke bakin tafkin. Wasu 'yan siyasa sun iza matasa, suka ba su kuɗi da sanduna. Su kuma 'yan adawa suna wani taro a kusa. Wani ya jefa dutse, sai gumurzu ya ɓarke. An yi awa biyu ana gumurzu a kasuwa da titi. Mutane ashirin sun ji rauni, an ƙona shaguna uku.

'Yan sanda sun ce sun kama matasa goma sha biyu, kuma wasu daga cikinsu sun ce wani na kusa da gwamna ne ya iza su. Gwamna ya musanta haka. Amma gumurzun ya dusashe farin jininsa a garuruwan bakin tafki. Masunta da suka yi murna da alƙawarinsa yanzu suna cewa, "Mun ji ana iza yaranmu don faɗa, ba don ceton tafki ba." Ko magoya bayansa sun yarda cewa gumurzun ya dusashe damarsa ta samun tazarce.

Rikicin ya kuma ɗakushe shirin tafkin kansa. Kamfanin da zai yi aikin ya ce ba zai fara ba sai an samu zaman lafiya. Masu ba da tallafi daga waje ma sun ce za su jira. Wani masani a jami'a ya ce mini, "Siyasa ta ɗakushe shirin kafin ma a fara shi."

Ra'ayina shi ne: tafki ba kayan yaƙin neman zaɓe ba ne. Ko wa ya ci zaɓe, ya kamata a yi nazari mai kyau, a rayar da tafkin saboda masunta da manoma, ba saboda tazarce ba. Kuma duk wanda ya iza matasa su yi faɗa, a hukunta shi.

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa Gwamna Shamsuddeen ya yi alƙawarin tafki?
Domin yana neman tazarce, wato a sake zaɓensa.
Me Hajiya Ladidi ta yi game da shirin?
Ta caccaki shirin, ta ce ba shi da kasafin kuɗi kuma ba a yi nazarin muhalli ba.
Me ya faru a taron gangami?
Wasu 'yan siyasa sun iza matasa, sai gumurzu ya ɓarke tsakaninsu da 'yan adawa.
Yaya gumurzun ya shafi gwamna?
Ya dusashe farin jininsa da damarsa ta samun tazarce.
Me ya sa kamfanin bai fara aikin ba?
Rikicin ya ɗakushe shirin; kamfanin ya ce sai an samu zaman lafiya.

lessons.title: Mai zane a Khartoum
lessons.summary: Raudha, a young Hausa-speaking painter in Khartoum, has drawn the river on sheets of paper since childhood; on the day of her first exhibition the lift in her building breaks, she carries her brushes and paintings down seven floors, paints the place where the Blue and White Nile meet, and an old teacher praises her talent.
lessons.text:
Raudha budurwa ce mai zane a Khartoum. Kakanninta Hausawa ne da suka zo daga Najeriya shekaru da yawa da suka wuce, suka zauna a Sudan. A gidansu ana magana da Hausa, a waje kuma da Larabci.

Tun yarantaka Raudha tana son zane. A lokacin yarantakarta, mahaifinta yakan kai ta bakin kogi a ranar Juma'a. A can Kogin Nilu mai shuɗi da Kogin Nilu fari suna haɗuwa. Ruwan ɗaya shuɗi ne mai duhu, ɗayan kuma kamar madara ne. Raudha takan zauna a kan duwatsu, ta zana kogin a kan warƙa. Mahaifiyarta ta ajiye kowace warƙa a cikin wani akwati. Bayan shekaru akwatin ya cika da warƙoƙi ɗari.

Yanzu Raudha tana da shekara ashirin da biyar, kuma tana zane da fenti da buroshi a kan zane mai faɗi. Tana zaune a hawa na bakwai na wani dogon gini, saboda haka kullum tana amfani da lif.

Wata rana aka gayyace ta ta nuna zanenta a wani baje kolin zane a bakin kogi. A safiyar ranar, ta shirya zanenta guda takwas, da akwatin buroshinta, ta je ta danna maɓallin lif. Lif bai zo ba. Mai gadin ginin ya ce, "Lif ya lalace tun dare. Mai gyara sai gobe."

Raudha ta yi tunani: hawa bakwai, zane takwas. Babu wata hanya. Ta ɗauki zane biyu, ta sauka a matakala, ta dawo, ta sake ɗauka. Ɗan maƙwabcinta ya ga tana gumi, ya taimaka mata. Har akwatin buroshi da tsofaffin warƙoƙinta na yarantaka suka sauka. Ta ce, "Yau lif ya koya mini haƙuri."

A wurin baje kolin, babban zanenta shi ne na wurin da Nilu biyu suke haɗuwa. Ta yi amfani da buroshi mai faɗi don ruwan shuɗi, da ƙaramin buroshi don layin da ke raba ruwan biyu. Kusa da shi ta ajiye wasu daga cikin warƙoƙinta na yarantaka, don mutane su ga yadda ta fara.

Wani tsohon malamin zane ya daɗe yana kallon zanen. Ya ce mata, "Hazaƙa ba ta zuwa rana ɗaya. Na ga warƙoƙinki na yarantaka. Hazaƙar tana nan tun kina ƙarama, amma aiki ne ya ƙara mata haske." Wata mata ta sayi babban zanen a ranar.

Da dare Raudha ta koma gida, sai ta ga lif ya gyaru. Ta yi dariya, ta hau, tana riƙe da buroshinta.

Tambayoyi:
Tun yaushe Raudha take son zane?
Tun yarantaka take son zane.
A kan me take zana kogin lokacin tana ƙarama?
Takan zana shi a kan warƙa.
Me ya faru da lif a ranar baje kolin?
Lif ya lalace tun dare, sai ta sauko a matakala.
Wane buroshi ta yi amfani da shi don ruwan shuɗi?
Ta yi amfani da buroshi mai faɗi.
Me tsohon malamin zane ya ce game da hazaƙarta?
Ya ce hazaƙarta tana nan tun tana ƙarama, amma aiki ne ya ƙara mata haske.
